text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Asahi Hai F.S. drawing closer, Maruzensky is enjoying her time training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Special Week and Grass Wonder request to practice alongside their role model, Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Moved by the passion of the younger students, Maruzensky gets even more fired up for the Asahi Hai F.S.!
